name: Premium 2.0 - using the line in Mexico and Canada
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: frequent traveler, light Spanish.
scripted_messages: Hola! (sorry, habit) I travel to Mexico and Canada a lot for work and I'm tired of roaming surprises. I want 1 line on Premium 2.0 with my own unlocked iPhone 16. I read Premium 2.0 includes talk, text and data in Canada, Mexico and some Latin American countries. What exactly does that cover when I'm in Mexico, and what's the monthly price?
Thank you. Is the data speed in Mexico the same as in the US?
And can I use the hotspot there too?
Okay, one small detail, do I need to turn something on before I travel or does it just work?
Perfect, that's a huge relief. You were super friendly and clear, thank you!
No, that's all! Gracias, have a great rest of your day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 7: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 8: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
